summary:
CRC outreach worklist 'Okafor CRC 2026' (grp-okafor-crc, 4 members) worked per RBC-QM-02. Four items arrived in the inbox as work started (08:00). Each was reviewed and is reflected in the decisions below, and each was completed with a comment. No further arrivals came in.

| Patient | Age at 12/31/2026 | Status | Reason | Action |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow | 72 | Open gap | The only frailty diagnosis (cond-00189) was marked entered in error by Dr. Lin (comm-00301). Without frailty, the frailty + advanced illness exclusion does not apply, even though she takes donepezil. No hospice or palliative care, nursing home or CRC. No colonoscopy, sigmoidoscopy, CT colonography or stool test on record. | FIT kit ordered (sr-t0001); outreach message sent (comm-t0004) |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan | 52 | Excluded | Hospice care 06/16/2026 to 08/21/2026 (eoc-00002, finished; St. Brigid discharge summary doc-00402) falls in the measurement period. Leaving hospice to join a trial does not change this. | No order, no contact |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss | 52 | Open gap | The lab corrected the only FIT (obs-01732): it was collected 12/31/2025, not 01/05/2026, so it falls outside 2026. No other screening and no exclusion. No active FIT order. | FIT kit ordered (sr-t0002); outreach message sent (comm-t0005) |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver | 51 | Open gap | Harbor Lab withdrew the 06/11/2024 sDNA-FIT (obs-01871, now entered in error; doc-00401). The 2025 colonoscopy order sr-00003 was never done, and an order does not count as screening. No exclusion. No active FIT order. | FIT kit ordered (sr-t0003); outreach message sent (comm-t0006) |

All FIT orders have a window of 2026-10-23 to 2026-12-31. The patient messages say the kit is on its way and explain how to collect, label (including the collection date) and return it. They make no claims about past screening. Older inbox items unrelated to this worklist were left untouched.
